Windows Night Mode diagnostics: saves native MPV audio-filter warnings, compressor setup messages, toggle states and playback recovery events to a bounded local log. Click the document icon beside Night Mode to copy the log file path. Logs: %LOCALAPPDATA%\\PlayTorrio\\logs\\night-mode-diagnostics.log. Submit after reproducing the failed toggle. Windows-only diagnostic build; Night Mode behavior is not yet fixed. iOS unchanged.\n
